what: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners bottles and sells Coca-Cola products. It does not own the brands: it buys concentrate from The Coca-Cola Company, makes the drinks, and distributes them across Western Europe, Australia, New Zealand, Indonesia and the Philippines.
customers: Supermarkets, convenience stores, restaurants, bars, vending operators and wholesalers.
money: bottling and distribution across Western Europe
Australia, New Zealand, Indonesia and the Philippines
moat: Exclusive territorial bottling rights for the world's best-known drinks brands, with a delivery network reaching millions of outlets.
risks: It depends entirely on an agreement with The Coca-Cola Company
Sugar taxes and packaging regulation raise costs in Europe
Debt of about $13 billion from the Amatil acquisition
Analyst targets imply the shares are already fully valued
opportunities: Revenue grew about 16% last year with a 12% return on invested capital
Indonesia and the Philippines are young, growing markets with low consumption per head
Energy drinks and zero-sugar variants grow faster than classic cola
watch: Volume growth in Asia Pacific and revenue per case in Europe.
